fusions.name: Fly-Catcher
fusions.desc: Lashes out, dealing 7 water damage to the target, up to 2 times that at maximum range. Anything struck moves 25% slower for 2 seconds, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Pond Chorus
fusions.desc: A cone of sound deals 12 resonating damage to everything in it and stuns each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone in a Glance
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You leap 3 tiles as you use it.

fusions.name: Gathered Breath
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a shriek strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (122% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
